roleDefinition: A learner who can independently produce and explain small warning-clean C17 programs using core syntax, typed values, formatted I/O, validation, loops, arrays, functions, bounded strings, pointers to live objects, structs, checked text files, debugging, dependency-free checks, Git, and clear build instructions.
evidenceSummary: The capability boundary was triangulated across current C teaching, compiler/library documentation, debugger guidance, and GitHub safety material, then constrained to eight six-hour instructional Weeks.

capabilityTiers.outcome: Compile and run code, reason about typed values, repair diagnostics, validate numeric input, make decisions, and process fixed arrays within bounds.
Decompose multi-file behavior, manage bounded text and live-object pointers, model records, persist defensively, debug, and run dependency-free checks.
Integrate proven C competencies into a documented, verified, persistent command-line application and publish source safely.

professionalPractices: read the first relevant diagnostic before editing
validate conversions, ranges, capacities, and divisors before use
keep pointers tied to live objects
test normal, boundary, invalid, missing, and malformed cases
preserve failed input and existing files for diagnosis
document exact build and run commands
graduationBoundary: Write, compile, debug, verify, document, and publish small warning-clean C17 programs with enough fluency for introductory practical examinations and beginner projects.
technologyDecision: MSYS2 UCRT64 GCC/GDB, VS Code, PowerShell, the C standard library, Git, and GitHub provide a maintained Windows route with high practical-exam value and no paid IDE requirement.
